description: Assignee select lists two identical options 'Setup agent · agent' (one per human's setup agent). The header avatar row also shows 'SA SA'. Assigning work to the right agent is guesswork.
expected: Each Actor option is distinguishable (owner name, harness or handle), e.g. 'Setup agent (Daniel) · agent'.
actual: Options: Unassigned, Setup agent · agent, Daniel Reyes · human, Priya Nair · human, Setup agent · agent.
suggested_fix: Disambiguate duplicate display names with the sponsoring human or harness in Actor labels (select options, avatars, cards).

description: Tags entered on create are stored (['auth','ios']) but appear neither on the card nor in the task detail; only the Edit task form shows them.
expected: Tags are visible in task detail (and optionally as chips on cards) once set.
actual: No tag display outside the edit form.
suggested_fix: Show tags in the detail summary area; consider small chips on cards.

description: The CLI refuses arbitrary agent names (agent-grant --harness codex-harbor → 'Unsupported execution harness'); agents are named 'Setup agent' regardless of the work they do, so a persona agent like 'codex-harbor' cannot exist.
expected: An agent can be given a recognizable display name at grant time.
actual: Display name fixed by setup ('Setup agent').
suggested_fix: Allow --name on agent-grant (client serve already accepts --name) or show the harness in the label.
